title: FX Senshi Kurumi-chan

thread.title: FX Fighter Kurumi-chan • FX Senshi Kurumi-chan - Episode 5 discussion

opinions.point: Many commenters enjoyed the episode's darkly comedic portrayal of trading obsession and escalating greed.
The internal conflict sequences were frequently praised as memorable and psychologically effective.
Yasuko was widely viewed as the most sensible and relatable character, while Mebuki and Kurumi were criticized for reckless, addiction-like behavior.
Several commenters disliked how easily the show makes profitable trading appear and warned that the characters' confidence is unrealistic.
